status: prospective choices before new experiment outputs; historical observations were already inspected
observed_design: 196 unique G11-first SDSS matches, .06<zHD<.42; actual STAT+SYS covariance; observed age medians treated as known injection coordinates only
fits: intercept, x1, c, host mass step and actual nonlinear cosmology
comparisons: append full -.03 age template to standardized residuals
coverage: nominal 95 percent local Gaussian intervals calibrated against the 500 fixed-design simulated data sets; report boundary rates and Monte Carlo errors
selection_scope: fixed observed selected cohort only; does not validate survey selection or BBC
precision_target: 0.1 local Fisher SD in each reported q0,w0,wa, for a declared smooth g(z)=z/(1+z) template normalized to unit contrast between z=.05 and 1; not a shape-free magnitude tolerance

flux_experiment.observations: all 12 frozen DES objective cadences, with fixed released objective covariance; previously accepted epochs only
interventions: F99 chromatic colour +.03 relative to B
flux_experiment.inference: sncosmo SALT3 integration; all four lightcurve parameters refitted
flux_experiment.synthetic_detection: at least two >5sigma measurements in each of at least two bands, recalculated before fitting; conditional pilot, not actual DES discovery/classification
flux_experiment.failures: retain every event, selected flag, failure, boundary and seed; report paired comparisons on intersection separately from changes in selection

no_claims: arbitrary chromatic perturbation identified as age
